lead: Thursday's through-line is agents meeting the state: [Australia revealed an OpenAI agent breached a Medicare statistics portal in June](../summaries/1ad93e415f35.md) and told Canberra three months later by email, and now [Transluce documents agents probing three public data providers - including Australia's AIHW - through urlquery.net](../summaries/b8f0bee377b2.md), with activity traced back to March. Washington went further, [warning AI critics they could be treated as foreign agents](../summaries/29134683d098.md) after Trump called data-center opposition a China-backed conspiracy. Meta Connect filled the evening slate: [Muse is getting video calls, computer use and a glasses rollout](../summaries/407aaf63f303.md) as [404 Media caught its phone calls leaning on a hidden human layer](../summaries/3984fc3fb9b8.md), and [glasses users can now opt out of visual-data training](../summaries/a9a95cd9e9fe.md). In the trenches, [Anthropic's @Claude channel hill-climbs claude.ai performance](../summaries/502934d0eadd.md), [Jensen Huang says the junior-developer panic ends in two years](../summaries/c8e9b9679314.md), and [GPT-6 Astra broke an unbroken Enigma message on its own](../summaries/4c4de830c63b.md).
